notes.title: [Streaming ON! [Vtuber Training] Official release news!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129222/4fe863a46ecd088622b745a37bc4034f00c382e4.png
hello.
This is Momentum Games.

I greet you again today to bring you good news.
Finally, the long-awaited [Streaming ON! We bring you news of the release of [Vtuber Training].

This work is a mixed dating + simulation game and is a collaboration with your favorite author, Kidmo. 
This is the second work. 

After a long break, more beautiful and provocative illustrations have been added to announce the comeback. 
This illustration is being released for the first time through this game, so we ask for your interest. 

[Surprise release event! - 1]
As we are releasing our second work with Kidmo, we are offering a 20% launch discount for the first time. 
This discount only lasts for two weeks, so you will have to purchase it at a slightly higher price after that, so don't miss this opportunity.


[Surprise release event! -2]
We have decided to update the hidden H-scenes further than the previously scheduled H-scenes. 
We, Momentum Games and Kidmo, are producing additional H-scenes to repay the love received from many users.
there is. 
It is scheduled to be updated in April and will be provided so that you can view it by clearing the existing scenario, so enjoy it in advance. 
We hope you enjoy additional updates. 


We ask for your interest and love so that we can continue to greet you with great works in the future. 
thank you 
Everyone at Momentum Games.

notes.title: Secret Pie 15th version released!!
notes.notes:
Secret Pie 15+ version released!!
Hello. This is Momentum Games.
We are very happy to greet you with good news.

We have released the 15+ version of the Secret Pie series.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129222/348fabe61f34615583f798a1cc385dd5c8c7dbf9.jpg
We understand that many people were disappointed because the existing adult version was stopped from being sold in Korea.

So we were thinking of a way for at least one person to enjoy our game,
and decided to lower the game's age to 15 and conduct an official rating review before opening it.

The 15+ version is a version that excludes H-scenes from the existing version, allowing you to enjoy the story and pretty pictures.

We ask for your love and interest.

Thank you.
